title: Bosch On Campus Drive
excerpt: Invitation to participate in the much-anticipated Bosch On Campus Drive. A transformative opportunity for engineering careers.
content: Attention all aspiring engineers! Kingston Engineering is thrilled to extend a warm invitation to each and every one of you to participate in the much-anticipated "Bosch On Campus Drive". This exciting event promises to be a transformative opportunity for students seeking to kickstart their careers in the dynamic world of engineering. Bosch, a global leader in technology and engineering solutions, is set to grace our campus with an exclusive recruitment drive aimed at identifying and nurturing the brightest minds in the field. As one of the foremost innovators in automotive technology, industrial solutions, consumer goods, and beyond, Bosch offers a plethora of career avenues for budding engineers across various disciplines.

title: Schneider Electric’s On Campus Drive
excerpt: Exclusive opportunity with a global powerhouse in sustainability and efficiency solutions. Join the Schneider Electric team.
content: Kingston Engineering is thrilled to extend a warm invitation to all its students for the much-anticipated event – "Schneider Electric's On-Campus Drive." This exclusive opportunity promises to be a gateway to a dynamic career in one of the world's leading energy management and automation companies. Schneider Electric, a global powerhouse in sustainability and efficiency solutions, is seeking bright minds to join its diverse team. As the world races towards a sustainable future, the role of engineers in shaping innovative solutions becomes paramount. Through this drive, Schneider Electric aims to scout for talented individuals.

title: Sutherland Global Solution’s On-Campus Drive
excerpt: Highly anticipated recruitment drive by Sutherland Global Solutions. Explore careers in digital transformation.
content: Kingston Engineering is thrilled to extend a warm invitation to all students to participate in the highly anticipated "Sunderland Global Solutions On-Campus Drive. This event is a great platform for our students to explore global career opportunities in the tech and services industry. Sutherland is a digital transformation company that can help you build a career at the intersection of technology and design.

title: Xploria On Campus Drive
excerpt: Delve into innovation and engineering excellence with the Xploria On Campus Drive event.
content: Attention all engineering enthusiasts! Kingston Engineering is thrilled to extend a warm invitation to each and every one of you for our upcoming event - "Xploria On Campus Drive". This promises to be an exciting opportunity for students to delve into the realms of innovation, exploration, and engineering excellence, right here on our campus grounds. Scheduled to take place on 2nd February 2024, "Xploria On Campus Drive" is set to be a dynamic platform where aspiring engineers can engage, learn, and network with industry experts.

title: YRO Systems On campus drive
excerpt: Gateway to career opportunities in engineering with YRO Systems. Connect with industry leaders.
content: Kingston Engineering, a hub of innovation and academic excellence, is thrilled to extend a warm invitation to all its bright minds for the eagerly awaited "YRO Systems On-campus Drive." This exciting event promises to be a gateway to an array of career opportunities in the dynamic field of engineering. The "YRO Systems On-campus Drive" is not just another recruitment event; it's an exclusive platform where aspiring engineers can connect with one of the industry leaders, YRO Systems, renowned for its cutting-edge technologies.

title: ICBAI Conference Insights
excerpt: International Conference on Business Analytics and Intelligence. Exploring modern data strategies.
content: The International Conference on Business Analytics and Intelligence (ICBAI) remains a milestone event at Kingston. This session provided a deep dive into modern data strategies and organizational intelligence. Faculty and students engaged with global experts to understand how artificial intelligence and big data are reshaping the global business landscape.

title: Communication Skill & Self Motivation
excerpt: Master the twin pillars of success. Seminar on active listening and maintaining high drive.
content: Effective communication and self-motivation are the twin pillars of personal and professional success. In our recent seminar, industry veterans shared techniques for active listening, persuasive speaking, and maintaining a high drive even in challenging environments. Students learned that while technical skills get you through the door, it's the ability to communicate and stay motivated that leads to leadership roles.

title: Skills and Attributes of Entrepreneurs
excerpt: Identifying risk-taking and resilience in budding leaders. Workshop on the entrepreneurial mindset.
content: Entrepreneurship is more than just starting a business; it's a mindset. Our latest workshop focused on key attributes like risk-taking, resilience, and vision. Students engaged in interactive sessions to identify market gaps and refine their problem-solving skills. The session concluded with a 'pitch-deck' competition where students presented innovative solutions to real-world problems.

title: Input to Market Analysis
excerpt: Data-driven approaches to understanding market dynamics. SWOT, PESTLE, and more.
content: Understanding market dynamics is crucial for any budding engineer or business leader. This session explored data-driven approaches to market analysis, covering SWOT, PESTLE, and customer segmentation to provide actionable insights for project development. Experts from the industry demonstrated how to use digital tools to track market trends and consumer behavior.

title: Today's Diamond was a piece of charcoal once
excerpt: Transformation through pressure. An inspiring session on perseverance for final-year students.
content: A poignant session on the power of transformation and perseverance. The speakers drew parallels between the formation of diamonds and the journey of students, emphasizing that pressure and time are essential for greatness. A truly inspiring event for our final-year students as they prepare for the challenges of the professional world. Remember, every challenge is just an opportunity to shine brighter.

title: Placement Orientation Program
excerpt: Map your career path. Comprehensive roadmap for the recruitment season and mock interviews.
content: Preparing for the corporate world requires strategy and discipline. Our annual Placement Orientation Program (POP) provided students with a comprehensive roadmap for the upcoming recruitment season, including mock interviews, resume reviews, and aptitude training. The session was conducted by senior HR professionals from Tier-1 MNCs who shared what they look for in a candidate.

title: Navigating HR in Healthcare
excerpt: Intersection of HR and Health-Tech. Understanding the unique challenges of the medical sector.
content: The healthcare sector presents unique HR challenges. This specialized talk focused on the intersection of technology and human resource management within hospitals and medical research firms, highlighting the growing demand for tech-savvy HR professionals. Topics included medical ethics, healthcare compliance, and managing large-scale medical staff during crises.

title: 78th Independence Day Celebration
excerpt: Flag hoisting and patriotic fervor. Celebrating the spirit of youth in nation-building.
content: Kingston Engineering College celebrated the 78th Independence Day with great patriotic fervor. The event featured the flag hoisting ceremony, cultural performances by students, and a stirring address by our Chairman on the role of youth in nation-building. The winners of various nationalistic competitions were also awarded during the ceremony.

title: A Better Tomorrow: Social Welfare
excerpt: Community development and awareness. Students partnering with NGOs for social impact.
content: Sustainability and social responsibility are core values at Kingston. Our social welfare awareness drive brought together students and NGOs to discuss community development, environmental protection, and the importance of giving back to society. The day included a clean-up drive and a donation camp for local underprivileged communities.

title: From Concept to Silicon
excerpt: Decoding modern system architectures. Lifecycle of chip development and AI-driven SoCs.
content: A masterclass on the future of semiconductor design. Students explored the lifecycle of chip development, from initial architectural concepts to the physical silicon, with a focus on modern AI-driven system-on-chip (SoC) architectures. Industry leaders from VLSI firms provided hands-on insights into the tools used for modern chip fabrication.
